issues.explanation: The whole feature ships without a single Pest/PHPUnit test, violating the project's mandatory TDD rule and leaving the mention format, invalid-id rejection and 1800-char truncation unverified.
The '$maxBase < 0' clamp is dead code: a 17-20 digit id makes the suffix at most 24 characters, so the subtraction can never go negative.
'is_int($value) && ! is_bool($value)' can be reduced to 'is_int($value)' because is_int() already returns false for booleans.
When $base is empty the result starts with a bare newline ('\n<@id>'); guarding the empty base would make the 'own line after the content' rule explicit.

review.summary: The change adds a validated optional Discord mention id (config/services.php, .env.example) that is appended on its own line by DiscordOpsAlert::formatContent while reserving room for it inside the 1800-character limit, and updates the CHANGELOG plus both ops docs. The implementation is small, secure and meets every stated requirement, but it ships with no tests at all, which the project's TDD convention treats as incomplete; that is why it needs changes before merging.
